title: Idempotent document-ingestion Lambda
scenario: S3 Object Created events flow through EventBridge and SQS to a Lambda that starts a Knowledge Base sync per tenant. The pilot started duplicate syncs, failed whole batches on ConflictException and let a poison message cycle for four hours. Rebuild it idempotent, with partial batch failure and a poison policy.
task: Parse the EventBridge S3 event and validate the tenant prefix and registry
Conditional job record per object version and a deterministic clientToken
Report only failed records in batchItemFailures; finish PENDING records on retry
Record and drop poison messages instead of redelivering them
acceptance: Three deliveries of one event: one job record, one StartIngestionJob call
Mixed batch reports only the failed record; conflict then retry finishes the job
Every poison case recorded, not redelivered, nothing started

practices.label: Week 7 Tue - SQS with Lambda, partial batch failure, DLQs
Week 7 Thu - timeouts, retries and backoff with jitter
